name: Data Galactica MCP
summary: MCP and API that resolve organisations and people to permanent Galactica IDs from public registers, with free daily calls and prepaid credit.
description: Paid MCP at https://datagalactica.com/mcp (OAuth or Bearer/X-API-Key) and https://api.datagalactica.com/mcp; a keyless free tier is at https://datagalactica.com/auth.md (25 data calls a day per address, no contacts, list pages up to 25 rows). Records start from company registers, GLEIF LEI, SEC filings and Wikidata. Signup gives ₹50 free credit (about 125 calls), then ₹0.40 per answered call. Search tools cover companies and people (contacts need purpose); meta and account routes are free. llms.txt and auth.md document agent signup.

agent_access.notes: OAuth or API key on /mcp; keyless free MCP at /mcp/free. Protected-resource metadata on datagalactica.com.
